findings.description: For executed hops setRoute requires only swapParams[h][2] != 0. Router NG v1.1 (0x16C6..., verified source, exchange loop) dispatches swap_type 1..8 and otherwise `raise "Bad swap type"`. A route with swap_type >= 9 (e.g. the ERC4626 type emitted by newer Router NG versions / routing tooling, already noted as rejected by this router in test/fork/MainnetRoutes.sol) is stored as valid and then reverts every harvest that delivers that token. i/j/pool_type/n_coins and executed-hop pools are likewise unconstrained by design (story-007 out of scope); wrong indices revert 'Received nothing'.
findings.attackVector: None adversarial. Owner footgun of low surprise: owner copies a route from tooling targeting a newer router; setRoute's new 'params consistent with path' check reads as having validated it. Consequence is a loud revert of every harvest (Error('Bad swap type'), decodable by harvest.sh's generic Error(string) path) until the owner re-sets the route or callers exempt the strategy. Atomic: no strand, no value at risk.
findings.impact: Liveness only; recoverable by the owner in one call.
findings.recommendation: Optionally bound executed swap_type to 1..8 (`swapParams[h][2] - 1 >= 8` revert) to match the immutable router; or document that setRoute validates path shape only and operators should eth_call router.exchange (audit 01 safe-config guidance).

ledgerStatusAssessments.label: M-01
ledgerStatusAssessments.reasoning: k = first empty pool slot (L161-162) matches Router NG's break `i == 4 or _route[i*2+3] == empty`; every slot after 2k is forced zero (L164-166 InvalidRouteGap); delivered token path[2k] must equal sya.rewardToken() (L171-173); executed intermediates non-zero (L168-170). Router NG transfers only the last executed hop's output_token = path[2k] to the receiver, so no accepted route can deliver a non-reward token (or ETH) to the harvester; intermediates never leave the router. The only accepted route that does not deliver R is the k=0 reward-token route, which _sellYield never executes (L356). PoC replay fails at setRoute with InvalidRouteGap(10). Mock now follows Router NG (stop at first empty pool), so the unit suite would catch a regression. Not an incomplete fix.
